name: Delete Artifact
description: Delete artifacts created within the workflow run.

name.description: The name of the artifact to delete; multiple names can be supplied on new lines.

token.description: GitHub token with read and write access to actions for the repository.

useGlob.description: Indicates whether the name, or names, should be treated as glob patterns.

failOnError.description: Indicates whether the action should fail upon encountering an error.
